discovery_notes: 30 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet, blocked domains excluded. Mainly Disney Pins Blog, WDW News Today, AllEars, Disney Food Blog. Reseller listings (yourwdwstore, magicalears, everything-mousey, jd-collectibles, whatnot) ignored. BoxLunch Toy Story Land pins are licensed, out of cell. DLR-only items (Mickey's Halloween Party, Once Upon A Time, Windows of Evil, Tape Series, DLR gingerbread) excluded. Shared DLR+WDW series (Lattes, Donut Shop, Star Wars helmets/vehicles, St Patrick's, Doctors' Day) included. Conflicts: FotH AP nutcracker LE 1500 vs 1750; Simba Donut date Jul 14 vs Jul 19; MNSSHP boxed set $135 vs forum $130 (forum not recorded); WDW AP ornament set 1000 vs commenter 500. Lattes 'edition_type' on set relies on Oswald/Tinker Bell wording. Gaps: most monthly series members, box-set contents, Toy Story Land sizes, Mickey 90 jumbo size, AK 20th sizes. No prompt-injection seen.
